metadata.description: Metadata catalogue for project-held photographic working files associated with Karmein Chan and her public memorial.
metadata.asset_policy: Metadata only. Image binaries are not included in the Knowledge File package and this module does not grant reuse rights.
notes: Titles and descriptions are conservative editorial descriptions based on direct visual inspection.
Unknown dates, creators and original publication sources are omitted rather than inferred.
File checksums identify the project-held working copies inspected for this release.
Several records are alternate files or edited derivatives of the same underlying image.
